description: The two pie charts compare the distribution of different categories, with the left chart showing four slices and the right chart showing four slices as well. The left chart has slices labeled "Atomic Skill Fail" (dark teal, 68.0%), "Correct" (light teal, 12.0%), an unlabeled category (white, 8.0%), and "Reason E" (light blue, 12.0%). The right chart has slices labeled with percentages only, with the largest slice (teal, 55.0%), followed by slices representing 21.0% (light blue), 14.0% (white), and 10.0% (dark teal). Both charts have percentage labels inside the slices, and a legend is partially visible above the charts, indicating the color scheme for "Atomic Skill Fail", "Correct", and "Reason E". The slices in both charts are not visually emphasized or exploded, and they appear to be ordered by size, with the largest slice first.
